description: Read a parametric object attached to a canvas Space / Node / Segment and expose each of its parameters as a val-<key> output.
instructions: Reads the parametric object attached to a canvas Space / Node / Segment and republishes each of its parameters as a `val-<key>` value output — so an attached object's Properties can drive flow operations. Pick the Host kind; with 'Grab from selection' on it tracks the selected element of that kind (turn it off and type an id like Space001 to pin one). Emits VALUES only (no geometry) — pair it with a Space / Node / Segment source for the footprint. Wire each `val-<key>` into a downstream value input (e.g. val-front → Inset's valin-front).
